summary: Frontend-only E2E test (mobile 390x844, preview URL) of the new redesign: recipe VETRINA grid, merged 'Le Mie Ricette (aggiungi/scansiona)', split of 'Impostazione Macchine' vs 'Piano di Produzione (IA)', recipe photos, 6-step Laboratorio and avatars. rca_of_the_issue: RCA of the crash: in RecipeList.jsx the vetrina Card fallback renders <ChefHat .../> when r.image_url is falsy, but ChefHat was missing from the lucide-react import list. Mikilab recipes all have image_url so the mikilab grid rendered fine, hiding the bug; the personal collection (Laboratorio Passo 2) contained a recipe without a photo, so the first render threw ReferenceError and React unmounted the tree (dev overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors: ChefHat is not defined'), making the merged add/scan screen completely unusable. Fix: added ChefHat to the lucide-react import; re-ran the flow -> scan block + add-recipe-btn + 1 personal card render, no runtime overlay, no console errors.
